citations.title: Reporting Requirements
citations.requirement: CCL report by the next working day, then a written report within 7 days, for: any death; deaths from injury, abuse or other than natural causes (including deaths away from the facility); AED use; injury needing medical treatment; unusual incident or client absence that threatens health or safety; suspected psychological abuse; epidemic outbreaks; poisonings; catastrophes; fires or explosions. Written report must give client name/age/sex/admission date, date and nature of event, physician findings and treatment, and disposition. (c)-(d): suspected physical abuse of a dependent adult goes to the local ombudsman, CCL and law enforcement within 2 hours if serious bodily injury, otherwise within 24 hours (WIC 15630(b)(1)). (e): within 10 working days report organizational changes, mailing address changes, change of corporate CEO (with fingerprints), and plan-of-operation changes that affect services. (f)-(i): items (b)(1)(A)-(H) also go to the authorized representative; (E)-(G) go to the local health officer when appropriate; epidemic outbreaks go immediately to the local fire authority; substantiated complaints are copied to designated parties.

citations.title: Personal Rights
citations.requirement: (a)(1)-(10) personal rights: dignity; safe and comfortable accommodations; freedom from corporal or unusual punishment, humiliation, intimidation, ridicule, coercion, threat, mental abuse, punitive actions, interference with eating/sleeping/toileting, and withholding of shelter, clothing, medication or aids; being told the CCL complaint unit address and phone and confidentiality information; religious freedom; leaving the facility at any time (curfews and house rules allowed; not applicable to clients with a conservator or other legal authority); not being locked in any room or the premises (exterior doors and windows may be locked if clients can exit; other securing means need prior CCL approval); no restraining devices (postural supports and protective devices only under strict conditions); right to receive or reject medical care; being told the visiting policy (HSC 1512). (d) at admission the client and authorized representative are personally advised of and given the list of rights; (e) rights and visiting policy are posted prominently; (f) the licensee ensures the rights are honored.

citations.title: Health-Related Services
citations.requirement: Licensee ensures first aid and needed medical/dental care, including transportation. Clients are assisted with self-administration of prescription and nonprescription medications. ARF staff may assist with metered-dose and dry-powder inhalers only after training by a licensed professional, with written documentation of procedures and trained staff names, annual review by the professional, and training documented in personnel files. Staff may not give injections except as authorized by law; designated staff may assist with self-administration of injections. No forcing, hiding or camouflaging medication. PRN rules in (b)(4)-(6). Oxygen requirements in (e). First-aid training for direct care staff (f). First-aid supplies list (g). Emergency communication person and contact list at all times (h). Central storage rules (j)-(k) with records kept at least 1 year. Destruction of unretained prescriptions witnessed by the administrator and one other adult non-client, record kept at least 1 year (l).

citations.title: Personnel Requirements (general)
citations.requirement: Personnel competent and in numbers needed to meet client needs; CCL may require added staff (documented, with written reasons), considering client needs, services, physical plant and any emergency or disaster. Volunteers must be supervised and are not counted in the staffing plan. Staff who supervise or give care must be 18+. Direct supervision at potentially dangerous activities or areas; an adult non-client present whenever clients use a pool or body of water needing swim rescue, with a valid water safety certificate. On-the-job training topics in (f). Health screening including TB test by or under a physician no more than 1 year before or 7 days after employment (g). Ill personnel relieved of duty (h). California criminal record clearance or exemption before employment or initial presence (i). Clients are not substitutes for required staff (j). Coverage by capable personnel during absences (k). Care without physical or verbal abuse, exploitation or prejudice (l). All personnel instructed to report personal-rights violations (m). (o): ARFs using secured perimeters must train direct care staff in Emergency Intervention (§85300).

citations.title: ARF Application for License
citations.requirement: Financial plan of operation on CDSS forms. Start-up funds must cover the first three months of operation, and CCL may require written verification. Applicant submits administrator name, addresses, background and qualifications, and documentation of required education and administrator certification.

citations.title: ARF Personnel Requirements
citations.requirement: Licensee employs staff as necessary to provide care and supervision that meets client needs (b), and support staff for office work, cooking, cleaning, laundry and maintenance (c). Food service staffing must ensure clients' food service needs are met (e)(1). Services requiring specialized skills must be performed by licensed or certified personnel; where no license or certification exists, prior CCL approval is required for an unlicensed person to provide the service (f).

citations.title: Night Supervision
citations.requirement: Night staff (10 p.m.-7 a.m.) must be able to help in an emergency and be trained in the facility's planned emergency procedures and in first aid (b). Facilities with 15 or fewer clients need at least one person on call on the premises (c). For 7+ clients who rely on others for all ADLs, one person on duty, on the premises and awake, plus one more per additional 14 such clients (f). For Regional Center clients who rely on others for all ADLs, night supervision is as the RC requires but no less than (f)/(f)(1) (g). Where a signal system is required (§85088), a staff person is responsible for responding to it (i).

citations.title: Needs and Services Plan
citations.requirement: Before admission the licensee determines the program can meet the person's needs, then completes a written Needs and Services Plan. The plan covers: client desires and background; entrance to the facility; specific service needs; written medical assessment (§80069); mental and emotional functioning; mental health intake assessment if any (§85069.3); functional capabilities assessment (§80069.2); the HSC 1180.4(a) initial assessment on or before the day of admission; the individual emergency intervention plan (§85168.2(a)); and facility plans to meet the needs. The 1180.4(a) assessment includes input from the client, authorized representative and any person the client chooses; the client's advance directive on de-escalation, seclusion or manual restraint (honored unless it violates law or endangers safety); early warning signs and triggers; calming techniques; medical conditions raising restraint risk; and trauma history. If the client has a restricted health condition (§80092), the plan includes the Restricted Health Condition Care Plan (§80092.2). Involve the client or representative, participating relatives, the placement or referral agency, and the person responsible for admissions.

citations.title: Consumer Notes, Quarterly and Semi-Annual Reports
citations.requirement: Text fetched is the version operative until 5/1/2026: administrator ensures ongoing written consumer notes (community and leisure activities, overnight visits away, illness, SIRs, medical and dental visits, dated and signed entries); semi-annual progress reports for Service Level 2 and 3 facilities; quarterly reports for Level 4 (data summary under §56013(d)(4), barriers and actions taken) sent to the service coordinator within 30 days of quarter end. A version operative 5/1/2026 (amended in the DDS SIR rulemaking) is listed in LII but its text was NOT fetched. Confirm current text and how it applies to Levels 5-6.

citations.title: Personal Rights (ARF)
citations.requirement: Adds to §80072. Section number and title confirmed in the LII Article 6 index; full text not fetched. Subsections seen in search excerpts (LII, CDSS ARF self-assessment): (b)(1) visit before admission; (b)(2) relatives and authorized representative informed of care activities, including NSP changes; (b)(3) prompt answers to relatives' communications; (b)(4) private visits including advocacy representatives during waking hours; (b)(5) own clothes; (b)(6) personal items; (b)(7) possess and control own cash; (b)(8) individual storage; (b)(9) confidential phone calls; (b)(10) unopened mail; (b)(11) help voting; (b)(12) move from the facility per the admission agreement. Confirm against full text.

citations.title: Day Staff-Client Ratio
citations.requirement: Per fact-checked research: for Regional Center clients who rely on others for all ADLs, day staffing is as the RC specifies, no less than 1:3.

citations.title: ARF Buildings and Grounds
citations.requirement: Per fact-checked research: no more than two clients per bedroom; bedrooms not used as passageways.

citations.title: Fixtures, Furniture, Equipment and Supplies
citations.requirement: Per fact-checked research: 1 toilet and washbasin per 6 persons and 1 tub or shower per 10, counting live-in staff and family; per-resident bed, chair, nightstand, lamp and drawers (2 drawers or 8 cu ft); linens; hygiene supplies; emergency lighting; night lights; signal system where required.

citations.title: Fire Clearance
citations.requirement: Per fact-checked research: fire clearance is obtained through CCL; a separate clearance is required before admitting nonambulatory clients or persons 65+. §80072(a)(8)(D) requires a fire clearance before using a postural support that makes a client nonambulatory.

citations.title: Criminal Record Clearance
citations.requirement: Per fact-checked research: Live Scan clearance or exemption is required before staff presence. §80065(i) confirms clearance, exemption or an approved transfer before employment or initial presence; §80019(d) fingerprints are required for a new corporate CEO.

citations.title: Plan of Operation
citations.requirement: Per fact-checked research: written plan covering purpose, admissions, admission agreement, staffing plan, in-service plan, floor plan and grounds sketch, menus, transportation, rate and refund policy, handling of resident money, consultants and visiting policy. It must be kept current; changes that affect services go to CCL within 10 working days (§80061(e)(4)).

citations.title: ARF Plan of Operation
citations.requirement: Per fact-checked research checklist: ARF plan of operation includes the infection control plan (§85022(a)(1)) and consultants (§85022(a)(2)).

citations.title: Application for License
citations.requirement: Per fact-checked research: CCL orientation is completed before filing; sets application contents, including the lease and landlord information in (d)(3).

citations.title: ARF Administrator Qualifications and Duties
citations.requirement: Per fact-checked research: certified administrator, age 21+, high school diploma or GED; HIV/TB training within six months of becoming administrator and updated every two years ((k)); 7-15 client homes need one year of residential care experience.

citations.title: ARF Administrator Certification Requirements
citations.requirement: Per fact-checked research: 35-hour CDSS-approved Initial Certification Training Program; exam within 60 days of finishing, maximum 3 attempts ($100); apply on LIC 9214 within 30 days of passing, with LIC 508 and Live Scan (LIC 9163), $140 fee.

citations.title: ARF Administrator Recertification Requirements
citations.requirement: Per fact-checked research: 40 hours of continuing education every two years (4 hours on laws and regulations); up to 24 hours of RC-approved DDS training may count.

citations.title: Facility Service Levels
citations.requirement: Per fact-checked research: basic direct care staffing whenever residents are under facility supervision: Level 2 1 per up to 6; Levels 3/4A/4B 1 per up to 3; 4C-4E 1 per up to 2; 4F-4I 1 for the first resident. Above those resident counts, weekly direct care hours are added by level (§56004(d) table); 2-7 hours per resident per week of program preparation can count. Consultant hours of 8/12/16 per consumer per six months (§56004(f)). The text uses legacy levels; map to Levels 2-6 using the DDS crosswalk (L3 = old 3/4A/4B; L4 = 4C-4E; L5 = 4F-4H; L6 = 4I).

citations.title: Facility Service Level Approval Process
citations.requirement: Per fact-checked research: written service level request with administrator qualifications; RC decides within 45 days; a level change is allowed only on a change of ownership or when most residents' ID teams identify a new need ((c)(1)).

citations.title: Residential Services Orientation
citations.requirement: Per fact-checked research: the administrator completes the RC residential services orientation before the first admission. RCs hold it at least every six months.

citations.title: Program Design Requirements
citations.requirement: Per fact-checked research: written program design with org chart, purpose and outcomes, entrance/exit criteria, program preparation duties, staff qualifications and duty statements, sample schedule and training plan; Level 3 and 4 designs have extra content.

citations.title: Direct Care Staff Competency-Based Training and Testing
citations.requirement: Per fact-checked research: two 35-hour DSPT segments (year 1 and year 2) with tests or a challenge test; §56033(a)(2)(B) segment 2 within two years of hire. DDS DSPT is free to first- and second-year DSPs (dds.ca.gov/services/dspt).

citations.title: Administrator Qualifications and Continuing Education
citations.requirement: Per fact-checked research: 6/9/12 months of DD experience for Level 2/3/4 (RC may waive); 8/12/12 hours of annual continuing education.

citations.title: Direct Care Staff Qualifications and Continuing Education
citations.requirement: Per fact-checked research: 40-hour on-site orientation ((a)(1)) covering program design, IPPs, rights, medications, emergencies and fire, SIRs and abuse reporting; CE of 8 hours/year (L2) or 12 hours/year (L3-L4); Level 4 staff without 6 months' experience add 12 hours in the first six months. This section was amended in the DDS SIR rulemaking effective 5/1/2026; confirm current text.

citations.title: Vendor Application Requirements
citations.requirement: Per fact-checked research: DS 1890 with disclosures, service type (915/905), capacity and consultants; copy of license or proof of application; signed HCBS Provider Agreement ((a)(10)(J)) for Medi-Cal-eligible services.

citations.title: Regional Center Review of Vendor Application
citations.requirement: Per fact-checked research: 45-day review; the RC cannot approve or refer until the license is received ((c)).

citations.title: General Requirements for Vendors and Regional Centers
citations.requirement: Per fact-checked research: vendor allows monitoring access ((a)(2)); keeps records at least 5 years ((a)(3)); bills only authorized, delivered services and the rate is payment in full ((a)(10),(12)); vendored by the RC where the facility is located ((a)(14)); HCBS Provider Agreement ((a)(16)); no payment for pre-vendorization services and no referrals before vendorization ((d)(4)).

citations.title: Types of Services
citations.requirement: Per fact-checked research: service codes 905/910 owner-operated and 915/920 staff-operated residential facilities.

citations.title: Requirements for Special Incident Reporting by Vendors and Long-Term Health Care Facilities
citations.requirement: Not fetched. The LII page seen in search is the version operative until 5/1/2026; the DDS SIR rulemaking effective 5/1/2026 amended 54327, 54327.1, 56002, 56026, 56038, 56059 and 56093. Pre-5/1/2026 text: vendors report to the RC with case management responsibility (and the vendoring RC if different) by phone, email or fax immediately and within 24 hours of learning of the incident, then a written report within 48 hours, and concurrently copy any later written report sent to CCL. Categories include missing consumer with a missing-persons report filed, reasonably suspected abuse (physical, sexual, fiduciary, emotional/mental, physical or chemical restraint) and neglect, and the death of any consumer. DDS FAQ dated 6/12/2026 confirms 24-hour and 48-hour timelines under the amended rule; RCs may add reporting requirements beyond Title 17. Verify the post-5/1/2026 category list before finalizing.

citations.title: Special Incidents
citations.requirement: Section number and title confirmed in the LII Title 17 Subchapter 4 Article 5 index; text not fetched. Review for residential-facility SIR duties.

citations.title: Consumer IPP Objectives
citations.requirement: Section number and title confirmed in the LII Article 5 index; text not fetched. Governs facility handling of consumer IPP objectives.

citations.title: Elder/Dependent Adult Abuse Mandated Reporting
citations.requirement: Per fact-checked research: mandated reporter duties for abuse of elders and dependent adults. CCL timelines are restated in 22 CCR §80061(c)-(d): 2 hours for suspected physical abuse resulting in serious bodily injury, 24 hours otherwise.

citations.title: Independent audit / independent review of vendors
citations.requirement: Per fact-checked research: independent review if RC payments are $500,000-$1,999,999 a year; independent audit at $2,000,000 or more; due 9 months after fiscal year end.

citations.title: Lanterman Developmental Disabilities Services Act
citations.requirement: Per fact-checked research: entitlement to services and the statutory basis for regional center services and vendorization.

citations.title: Rights of persons with developmental disabilities
citations.requirement: Not fetched and not in research. Statutory list of rights of persons with developmental disabilities; verify subsections before citing in the manual.

citations.title: Individual Program Plan
citations.requirement: Cited in the fetched text of 22 CCR §80072(a)(8)(F)1. as the source of the Individual Program Plan (IPP). Section content not fetched; verify.

citations.title: Seclusion and behavioral restraints in facilities
citations.requirement: Not fetched. §1180.4(a) is cross-referenced in the fetched text of 22 CCR §85068.2(b)(1)(G) (initial assessment, advance directive on de-escalation, seclusion and restraint). A Westside Regional Center page lists HSC 1180-1180.6 as the seclusion and restraint law. Verify scope for ARFs.

citations.title: Community care facility license fees
citations.requirement: Per fact-checked research: 4-6 beds $908 with the application and $454 annual; late annual fee adds 50%. Facility is within the Community Care Facilities Act, HSC §1500 et seq.
